title: Queued VIXEN long witnesses need a supported detached launcher
body: The live queue-admitted VIXEN configure/build jobs were terminated by the interactive runner at its wall-time boundary before producing a target result. I had to write lane-local setsid launchers and poll explicit PID/log/status files so the queue slot could complete. Provide a supported detached long-job witness mode that preserves queue ownership and reports completion without lane-local process plumbing.

title: Real-Dozen editor capture CTest should have an enabled GPU route
body: With the supported WSL Mesa-Dozen ICD configured, VixenTesting marks the plain vixen_editor_capture_producer CTest entry DISABLED because it cannot use the discovered-test launcher. I had to invoke the identical producer directly through the GPU queue with vixen-gpu-env.sh to exercise the real driver. Provide a native GPU CTest launcher or an authoritative direct-producer wrapper so the registered capture test is not silently Not Run.
